extraction_method: manual structured extraction from Menjívar, Agadjanian & Oh 2022, 'The Contradictions of Liminal Legality', Social Problems 69(3):678-698. Based on a 2016 survey of Salvadoran and Honduran TPS holders in 5 US metropolitan areas.

value.population: Salvadoran and Honduran Temporary Protected Status (TPS) holders (the majority of immigrants on this status nationally)
value.legal_status: TPS — liminally legal, temporary, uncertain; renewals announced just months before expiration

study_population.quote: a unique survey of Salvadoran and Honduran TPS holders, the majority of immigrants on this status

educational_distribution.quote: Due to the already small fraction of those with at least some university education (9 percent of men and 10 percent of women)

origin_countries_emphasized.notes: Trump administration 'ended TPS designation' for El Salvador, Haiti, Honduras — creating termination anxiety that forms the civic-engagement response

tps_statutory_context.value: TPS created via Immigration Act of 1990; Secretary of Homeland Security designates countries facing armed conflict, environmental disaster, or other extraordinary conditions. Protection period 6-18 months; holders receive work permit. Renewals announced close to expiration.

education_earnings_decoupling.value: TPS holders do NOT derive significant occupational or earnings premium from higher educational attainment — Hypothesis 1-1.B and 1-2.B both supported. The standard education-earnings relationship that holds in the general population is absent among TPS holders.
education_earnings_decoupling.quote: TPS holders with higher levels of educational attainment do not derive commensurate significant occupational or earnings premiums from their education

partnered_earnings_gradient.value: Having a partner in the United States increases men's likelihood of holding a higher-skilled job and increases their earnings. Same not true for women.

country_of_education_not_significant.value: Where the TPS holder received their highest level of education (US vs origin country) is NOT significantly associated with earnings — unusual for immigrant populations generally.

salvadoran_vs_honduran_no_difference.value: No significant differences between Salvadoran and Honduran TPS holders in occupational level or earnings.

liminal_legality_as_vulnerability.value: TPS status is explicitly 'temporary and uncertain'; renewals announced just months before expiration. Workers operate under continual threat of loss-of-status.
liminal_legality_as_vulnerability.quote: Statuses that are liminally legal, and, therefore, temporary and uncertain, have expanded significantly, and today they can be conceptualized as a spectrum

termination_anxiety.value: Trump administration's decision to end TPS designation for El Salvador, Haiti, Honduras, Nepal created 'volatile climate' — existential uncertainty about work authorization.
termination_anxiety.quote: the volatile climate that the Trump administration has created with its decision to end TPS designation for several countries, even those that have been designated for this dispensation for years

incorporation_incompleteness.value: TPS holders show 'in-corporation incompleteness' (Brown & Bean 2006) — socioeconomic integration lags compared to more-secure-status immigrants and general population, while civic engagement follows typical patterns.

implied_exposures.value: Not directly enumerated in this paper. TPS populations are plausibly exposed to: (a) notario / immigration-service fraud targeting uncertain-status populations; (b) wage theft and misclassification (common in low-wage sectors where TPS holders concentrate); (c) remittance-corridor fraud on the Central American sending route.

civic_organization_engagement_more_educa.value: More educated TPS holders ARE more likely to participate in community organizations and voluntary community service — Hypothesis 2-1.A and 2-2.A supported. Civic engagement follows typical education gradient, unlike economic outcomes.
civic_organization_engagement_more_educa.quote: more educated TPS holders are more likely to be members of community organizations and to participate in voluntary community service

tps_alliance_mobilization.value: National TPS Alliance formed in response to termination announcements. Within two years: 60+ committees nationwide, demonstrations, legislative lobbying, lawsuits, status-information campaigns. High trust in community-based organizations serving the TPS population.
tps_alliance_mobilization.quote: the National TPS Alliance, the nation-wide organization that formed in the wake of the Trump administration's announcement to terminate TPS. In just two years, TPS holders have organized at least sixty committees

community_org_as_incorporation_channel.value: TPS holders engage in community organizations and rights movements to advocate for improving conditions that block their integration in other spaces (economic, institutional).

language_implied.value: Spanish-primary (Salvadoran and Honduran); English proficiency variable with US-education variable NOT significantly predicting earnings

suitable_for_grounding_fields: corridor_country (El Salvador, Honduras as sender origins)
family_crisis_history (TPS termination anxiety, renewal uncertainty, political climate)
income_usd_weekly (via education-earnings decoupling — TPS holders earn below education-predicted levels)
civic / trust patterns (community org membership, TPS Alliance affiliation)
not_suitable_for_grounding_fields: fraud_vector events (paper is about integration, not fraud typologies)
platform_mix / gig specifics (not a gig-worker-focused paper)
persona_grounding_implications.behavioral_evidence_grade_when_used: B — regulatory/academic typology source. Peer-reviewed empirical sociology; direct survey data from a defined population. Strongest for documentation_status + earnings context; limited for fraud-specific fields.
persona_grounding_implications.caveat: Study year is 2016, paper published 2022. TPS policy and designation landscape has shifted since (various designations extended, terminated, relitigated). For current-state persona grounding, pair with more recent regulatory tracking.
